slots.label: Heading 1
slots.default: Strong passwords alone are no longer enough

slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Managing passwords becomes increasingly difficult as businesses adopt more cloud platforms, business applications and remote working. Employees often need access to Microsoft 365, finance software, CRM systems and supplier portals every day, making it easy for weak password habits to develop over time.

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: Weak password security is rarely caused by one poor decision. More often it develops gradually as employees create accounts for new applications, reuse familiar passwords or share credentials to keep work moving. During account reviews we regularly find inactive accounts, passwords stored in spreadsheets and inconsistent authentication across Microsoft 365 and cloud services.

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: Password tooling is deployed, configured and supported end to end, including onboarding your team onto it, because a password manager nobody adopts protects nothing. WhizzIT is Cyber Essentials certified and a Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider, so our security fundamentals are independently assessed rather than simply claimed.

slots.label: Paragraph 5
slots.default: Common password security risks we find

slots.label: List item 1
slots.default: Passwords reused across multiple business platforms

slots.label: List item 3
slots.default: Business passwords stored in spreadsheets or unsecured documents

slots.label: List item 4
slots.default: Dormant user accounts retaining unnecessary access

slots.label: List item 6
slots.default: Limited visibility into credential management and user access
